subject.title: fix(matrix): normalize message fields and deduplicate streaming m.replace events for CLI display

question: Should Matrix `message read` expose deduplicated current-message state in the existing `messages` array, or preserve raw page-event semantics for JSON and agent-tool consumers?
rationale: Both behaviors are internally coherent, but the choice changes an existing channel payload contract and cannot be inferred safely from tests or CLI screenshots alone.

options.title: Approve canonical messages
options.body: Treat `messages` as the rendered current state, accept replacement compaction and original-target IDs, and document that raw timeline events are not exposed through this action.

options.title: Preserve raw messages
options.body: Land only the formatter projection and keep replacement events unchanged until a separate canonical-message view is designed.

options.title: Expose both views
options.body: Return canonical `messages` plus an explicit raw-event array, with focused compatibility tests defining both contracts.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical messages
recommendation.body: Treat `messages` as the rendered current state, accept replacement compaction and original-target IDs, and document that raw timeline events are not exposed through this action.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged-history signal for the Matrix action and message-reading contract points to this owner.
